summary: A 多音字 is one character with two or more readings, and the reading follows the meaning, not the character. Usually one reading is the everyday one (行 xíng, 长 cháng, 还 hái) and the other carries a separate meaning found in a small set of words (银行 yínháng, 长大 zhǎngdà, 还书 huánshū). Ask what the character means in this word, then pick the reading tied to that meaning.

subs.label: 了 得 着 地 的: light particle or full word
subs.focus: 了 le / liǎo (了解, 吃不了), 得 de / dé / děi (得到, 我得走了), 着 zhe / zháo / zhuó (睡着, 着急, 着手), 地 de / dì (地方, 地铁), 的 de / dí / dì (的确, 目的). Error: reading the particle in fixed words (le jiě, de dào) or a full tone on the particle.

subs.label: 还 都 只 和 没: everyday words, rare second reading
subs.focus: 还 hái / huán (还书, 还钱), 都 dōu / dū (首都, 成都), 只 zhǐ / zhī (一只猫), 和 hé / huo (暖和), 没 méi / mò (没收). Error: hái for give back, dōu in 首都, zhǐ after a number, hé in 暖和.

subs.label: 长 好 干 少 空: adjective or other meaning
subs.focus: 长 cháng long / zhǎng grow, head (长大, 校长, 长得), 好 hǎo / hào like (爱好, 好奇), 干 gān dry (干净, 干杯) / gàn do (干活), 少 shǎo few / shào young (少年), 空 kōng empty (空气) / kòng free time (有空). Error: the adjective reading everywhere.

subs.label: 数 种 处 发 背: thing or action
subs.focus: 数 shù number / shǔ count, 种 zhǒng kind / zhòng plant, 处 chù place (好处) / chǔ handle, get along (处理, 相处), 发 fā send / fà hair (理发), 背 bèi back, memorize / bēi carry on the back (背包). Error: one reading for both.

subs.label: 乐 觉 便 重 行: two unrelated words
subs.focus: 乐 lè happy / yuè music (音乐), 觉 jué feel / jiào sleep (睡觉), 便 biàn convenient / pián only in 便宜, 重 zhòng heavy / chóng again (重新), 行 xíng go, OK / háng row, trade (银行). Classic errors: yín xíng, biàn yi, shuì jué, yīn lè.

subs.label: 教 看 要 调 转: which verb is it
subs.focus: 教 jiāo teach + person or subject / jiào in set words (教室, 教育), 看 kàn look / kān look after (看孩子), 要 yào / yāo (要求), 调 tiáo adjust (空调, 调整) / diào tone, investigate (声调, 调查), 转 zhuǎn turn, pass on / zhuàn spin (转圈). Error: kàn, yào, diào everywhere.

subs.label: 为 当 应 中 相: everyday tone or set words
subs.focus: 为 wèi for (因为, 为了) / wéi as, take to be (认为, 以为, 成为), 当 dāng / dàng (上当, 适当, 当作), 应 yīng should / yìng respond (反应, 适应), 中 zhōng / zhòng hit (中奖), 相 xiāng / xiàng (照相, 相机). Error: wèi in 以为, zhōng in 中奖.

subs.label: 难 倒 差 假 间: learn the set words
subs.focus: 难 nán hard / nàn disaster (灾难), 倒 dǎo fall (摔倒) / dào pour, upside down (倒水), 差 chà poor, short / chā difference (差别, 时差) / chāi errand (出差), 假 jiǎ fake / jià time off (放假, 请假), 间 jiān (房间) / jiàn (间接). Error: jiǎ in 放假, chà in 出差.

rules.rule: As particles after a verb, 了 得 着 are light le, de, zhe. With their own meaning: liǎo = manage (了解, 吃不了); dé = get (得到, 获得); děi = have to; zháo = reach the result (睡着, 找着), 着急.
rules.pattern: Verb + 不了 / 得了 (can or can't manage) → liǎo; 得 + verb = must → děi; get, obtain → dé

examples.py: zhè me duō cài wǒ chī bu liǎo
examples.en: I can't finish this many dishes.

examples.py: tài wǎn le wǒ děi zǒu le
examples.en: It's too late, I have to go.

examples.py: tā dé le dì yī míng
hái zi shuì zháo le

rules.note: 着 is zhuó only in formal words such as 着手 (set about) and 着装 (dress). 了解 is liǎo jiě, never le jiě.

rules.rule: 地 means ground or place (地方, 地铁, 地图) and is dì; as the marker before a verb it is light de. 的 is de, except dí in 的确 and dì in 目的.
rules.pattern: Adverb + 地 + verb → de; 地 in a word for ground or place (地方, 地铁, 本地) → dì

examples.py: wǒ men zuò dì tiě qù ba
tā màn màn de zǒu guò lai
zhè ge bàn fǎ dí què bú cuò

examples.zh: 你来北京的目的是什么？
examples.py: nǐ lái běi jīng de mù dì shì shén me
examples.en: What is your purpose in coming to Beijing?

rules.rule: Keep the everyday reading unless the meaning changes: 还 huán = give back, 都 dū = capital or big city (首都, 成都), 只 zhī = measure word after a number or 这 / 那, 和 huo in 暖和, 没 mò = sink or confiscate.
rules.pattern: 还 + person/thing given back → huán; number + 只 → zhī

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān huán nǐ qián
běi jīng shì zhōng guó de shǒu dū
examples.en: Beijing is the capital of China.

examples.py: wǒ jiā yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu
examples.en: We have a little dog at home.

examples.py: jīn tiān hěn nuǎn huo

rules.note: 还 before a verb or adjective (还没, 还要, 还好) is hái. 没 is mò only in a few words like 没收 (confiscate); 没有 is always méi yǒu.

rules.rule: The adjective reading is the everyday one: 长 cháng long, 好 hǎo good, 干 gān dry, 少 shǎo few, 空 kōng empty. The other reading has its own meaning: zhǎng grow / head of, hào like to, gàn do, shào young, kòng free time.
rules.pattern: 长大, 校长, 长得 → zhǎng; 爱好 → hào; 干活 → gàn; 有空 → kòng

examples.py: hái zi zhǎng dà le
nǐ de ài hào shì shén me
nǐ zài gàn shén me
nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng ma

rules.note: 干净 and 干杯 are gān (dry, empty); 空气, 天空 and 空调 are kōng. 少 is shào only in words about youth such as 少年 and 少女; 多少 is duō shao.

rules.rule: Thing vs action: 数 shù number / shǔ count; 种 zhǒng kind / zhòng plant; 处 chù place / chǔ handle, get along; 发 fā send, start / fà hair. 背 is bèi (back, memorize) except bēi = carry on the back.
rules.pattern: Verb meaning: 数钱 shǔ, 种树 zhòng, 处理 chǔ; 理发 fà; 背包 bēi

examples.py: qǐng shǔ yi shǔ yǒu jǐ ge rén
examples.en: Please count how many people there are.

examples.py: yé ye zài yuàn zi lǐ zhòng huā
examples.en: Grandpa is planting flowers in the yard.

examples.py: wǒ men xiāng chǔ de hěn hǎo
tā měi tiān bèi dān cí

rules.note: Memorizing (背书, 背单词) is bèi, though it is a verb. 好处, 到处, 用处 are chù. 头发 is usually said tóu fa with a light second syllable; 理发 and 发型 keep fà.

rules.rule: 乐: happy lè, music yuè. 觉: feel jué, sleep jiào. 便: convenient biàn, but 便宜 (cheap) is pián yi.
rules.pattern: 快乐 lè / 音乐 yuè; 觉得 jué / 睡觉 jiào; 方便 biàn / 便宜 pián

examples.py: tīng yīn yuè ràng wǒ hěn kuài lè
examples.en: Listening to music makes me happy.

examples.py: wǒ jué de tā xiǎng shuì jiào
examples.en: I think he wants to sleep.

examples.zh: 这里买东西很方便，也很便宜。
examples.py: zhè lǐ mǎi dōng xi hěn fāng biàn yě hěn pián yi
examples.en: Shopping here is convenient and cheap.

rules.note: 午觉 (nap) is also jiào. 随便 and 顺便 are biàn.

rules.rule: 重: heavy or important zhòng, again chóng. 行: go, OK, travel xíng; row or line of business háng, as in 银行.
rules.pattern: 重要 zhòng / 重新, 重复 chóng; 自行车 xíng / 银行 háng

examples.py: zhè ge xiāng zi hěn zhòng
qǐng nǐ chóng xīn xiě yí biàn
wǒ qù yín háng qǔ qián
examples.en: I'm going to the bank to get money.

examples.py: wǒ men qí zì xíng chē qù ba

rules.note: 行 alone meaning 'OK' is always xíng. 一行字 (a line of text) and 行业 (industry) are háng.

rules.rule: 教 is jiāo when it is the verb 'teach' with a person or subject after it (教我们, 教汉语, 教书); in set words such as 教室, 教育, 教练, 请教 it is jiào. 看 is kān for looking after (看孩子, 看门). 要求 is yāo qiú.
rules.pattern: 教 + person + subject → jiāo; 教室 → jiào; 看孩子 → kān

examples.py: lǐ lǎo shī jiāo wǒ men hàn yǔ
wǒ men zài jiào shì shàng kè
examples.en: We have class in the classroom.

examples.py: nǎi nai zài jiā kān hái zi
examples.en: Grandma looks after the kids at home.

examples.zh: 妈妈要求我早点儿回家。
examples.py: mā ma yāo qiú wǒ zǎo diǎn r huí jiā
examples.en: Mom asks me to come home early.

rules.note: 调: tiáo = adjust or mix (空调, 调整), diào = tone, move, investigate (声调, 调查). 转: zhuǎn = turn toward, pass on (左转, 转告), zhuàn = spin round (转圈).

rules.rule: The everyday tone covers most words; the other tone lives in a short list. 为 wéi in 认为, 以为, 成为. 当 dàng in 上当, 适当. 应 yìng in 反应, 适应, 应用. 中 zhòng = hit, win. 相 xiàng = photo, looks.
rules.pattern: 认为, 以为 wéi; 上当 dàng; 适应 yìng; 中奖 zhòng; 照相 xiàng

examples.py: wǒ yǐ wéi nǐ bù lái le
tā zhòng le dà jiǎng

examples.zh: 你要慢慢适应这里的生活。
examples.py: nǐ yào màn màn shì yìng zhè lǐ de shēng huó
examples.en: You'll need to get used to life here bit by bit.

examples.py: wǒ men zhào zhāng xiàng ba

rules.note: Everyday side: 为什么, 因为, 为了 wèi; 当然, 当时 dāng; 应该 yīng; 中国, 中间 zhōng; 相信, 互相 xiāng.

rules.rule: Learn these as words: 假 jià = time off (放假, 请假, 暑假), jiǎ = fake. 差 chāi in 出差; chā = difference (差别, 差距, 时差); chà elsewhere. 倒 dǎo = fall (摔倒); dào = pour, upside down, and 'actually' (倒是).
rules.pattern: 请假 jià; 出差 chāi; 时差 chā; 倒水 dào; 摔倒 dǎo

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng qǐng liǎng tiān jià
examples.en: I'd like to take two days off.

examples.zh: 爸爸下星期去上海出差。
examples.py: bà ba xià xīng qī qù shàng hǎi chū chāi
examples.en: Dad is going to Shanghai on business next week.

examples.py: wǒ gěi nǐ dào bēi shuǐ
examples.en: I'll pour you a glass of water.

examples.py: tā zài lù shang shuāi dǎo le
examples.en: He fell over on the road.

rules.note: 难 is nán (hard) except nàn = disaster (灾难, 难民). 间 is jiān (房间, 时间, 中间) except jiàn = gap, indirect (间接). 差不多 and 差一点 are chà.

contrasts.why: The mistake is in the sound: yín xíng. 行 is háng when it means a business or a row, so 银行 is yín háng.

right.py: zhè jiàn yī fu hěn pián yi
right.en: This piece of clothing is cheap.

contrasts.why: Said biàn yi by analogy with 方便. 便 is pián only in 便宜, and that word must be learned as pián yi.

right.en: I want to go to sleep.

contrasts.why: Said shuì jué by analogy with 觉得. Sleep is jiào; jué is only the 'feel, sense' meaning (觉得, 感觉).
Said yīn lè because 快乐 is kuài lè. 乐 is yuè when it means music: 音乐, 乐器.

right.py: hái zi zhǎng de hěn kuài

contrasts.why: Said cháng de. Growing is zhǎng; cháng is only the adjective 'long'. 长得 (grow, look like) is always zhǎng.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān huán nǐ shū
right.en: I'll give you your book back tomorrow.

contrasts.why: Said hái, which would mean 'still'. Here 还 is the verb 'give back', followed by the person and thing: huán.

right.py: nǐ míng tiān yǒu kòng ma

contrasts.why: Said yǒu kōng. Free time is kòng; kōng is 'empty, sky, air' as in 空气 and 空调.

right.py: lǐ lǎo shī jiāo wǒ men huà huà
right.en: Teacher Li teaches us to draw.

contrasts.why: Said jiào by analogy with 教室. 教 as the verb 'teach' with a person or subject after it is jiāo; jiào is for set words like 教室, 教育, 请教.

right.py: nǐ de ài hào shì shén me

contrasts.why: Said ài hǎo. 好 meaning 'like, be fond of' is hào: 爱好, 好奇. hǎo is 'good'.

right.py: wǒ men xià ge yuè fàng jià
right.en: We have a holiday next month.

contrasts.why: Said fàng jiǎ. 假 meaning time off is jià (放假, 请假, 暑假); jiǎ means fake.

cheat: Particle after a verb → light le / de / zhe. Full readings only in set words: 了解 liǎo, 得到 / 获得 dé, 得 = must děi, 睡着 zháo.
地方, 地铁 dì; 的确 dí; 目的 dì. Give back 还 huán; capital 都 dū; number or 这 + 只 zhī; 暖和 huo.
Grow / head 长 zhǎng, like 好 hào, do 干 gàn, young 少 shào, free time 空 kòng.
Count 数 shǔ, plant 种 zhòng, handle 处 chǔ, hair 发 fà, carry on the back 背 bēi.
Music 乐 yuè, sleep 觉 jiào, 便宜 pián, again 重 chóng, bank or trade 行 háng.
Teach (verb) 教 jiāo, look after 看 kān, 要求 yāo, 空调 tiáo, spin 转 zhuàn.
以为 / 认为 wéi, 上当 dàng, 适应 yìng, win 中 zhòng, photo 相 xiàng, time off 假 jià, 出差 chāi, pour 倒 dào.
